name: nav-tree
title: Nav Tree
description: A column's navigation: titled sections of items left-aligned with their title, children indented one 12px step under their parent, counts, an inset rounded active state, a fold control at a parent's end, arrow-key navigation and a 44px touch size.

meta.whenToUse: The places in an app's module column — views, saved filters, spaces with their sections, folders, settings pages — in the shell's ShellColumn or a phone sheet.
meta.whenNotToUse: A file browser with drag and drop (FolderTree), a page's own tabs (Tabs), or the module rail (Rail).
